site.name: Sic et Non
site.tagline: Twenty debates between atheism and Christianity, both sides at their strongest.
site.description: Twenty debates between atheism and Christianity. Each argument as its best defenders state it, with real quotations from the thinkers who made them.
home.intro: Twenty questions people argue about. On each one you get the best case for both sides, in the words of the people who made it. The site never tells you who won.
status.settled-core.meaning: There is a factual core here that the relevant experts have settled. The remaining dispute is about what it means, not about the facts.
status.open.meaning: A live dispute. Serious, well-informed people land on both sides.
status.interpretive.meaning: No new evidence will settle this. In the end it is a choice about how to read the world.
status.label: Status
about.title: About this site
footer.builtWith: A static site. No accounts, no comments, no tracking.
footer.license: Quotations belong to their authors and are used for comment and criticism.
quote.verification.corroborated.note: Wording confirmed across several independent sources, but not yet read in the original.
quote.verification.paraphrase.note: Not a direct quotation. The exact wording could not be confirmed, so this states the writer's point in our words.
